entry.title: Karnak Temple Complex

groundCutout.basis: Approximate exterior placement from retained standard viewer PMTiles and unmodified161-square/16m DEM plus ordinary pictures. The hypostyle-hall control anchors the signed26-degree axis;native+X points ESE,+Z SSW,+Y up. NativeY0 is the DEM sample at the exact model anchor. Independent temple/shrine groups use retained-DEM neighborhood medians;processional and approach ramps connect their levels. Both lake levels use retained native-water lower quartiles. Thirty-one covered ground pockets and52separate building masks preserve432independent retained building records. Actual DEM tile:365independent records unchanged. Native-water replacement is limited to the two modeled lake footprints;failed loads,partial residency and eviction preserve or restore unloaded surfaces. Architectural grades and point-derived envelopes/facing remain visualization estimates,not surveyed archaeological elevations or hydrology.

buildingCutout.basis: Independent building-only masks for 52 mapped authored controls,with a 3 cm outward allowance for numerical edge slivers. Every independent retained building and inner courtyard hole is preserved,with a 2 mm numerical guard;these allowances are not surveyed precision. Masks with holes are partitioned into simple pieces;no synthetic connectors,whole-precinct extrusion or archaeological-relation replacement.

waterCutout.basis: Only the mapped Amun sacred-lake and Isheru crescent footprints. Other components and independent water features sharing an ID stay intact. Ground and water replacement are separately bounded and follow resident model pieces;native water returns on unload or failed loading.

entry.note: Q522862/relation14358790 is retained as archaeological identity only,never a single extruded building. Separate standard PMTiles controls identify the authored Amun core and its eastern pylon fragments,shrines,open court,exterior walls,Akhmenu ranges and exterior east temples. Mapped room/ruin containers are not blindly filled as complete roofs. Named information points are labels,not building centers. The sacred lake water is a component of PMTiles water multipolygon260831100,with a separate named point35184398171942.
